records.rationale: One bounded test-only correction; preserve r11 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Add a bounded exact-time-carry witness using a fresh 1x1 FixedGrid with step_ms=u64::MAX and ordinary borrowed default HeldInput. Consecutive elapsed values u64::MAX-1, u64::MAX, and 1 must return 0, 1, and 1 respectively, with coordinates remaining (0,0); a following zero-elapsed call must return 0. The mathematical intermediate carry, rather than saturation, determines the final step. Preserve the existing valid bulk-work, maximum representable step-count, partial/exact interval, independent-axis/opposing-direction, clamping, constructor validation-order and input-nonmutation tests. Before every existing test path that requests an astronomical number of logical steps, run and assert the same bounded three-call witness on a separate fresh grid within that test function, before reaching the large call; a reusable test helper is acceptable. Do not rely on test function names, source-file ordering, serial test execution or cross-test state to enforce this prerequisite: Rust tests can run concurrently and an assertion failure in a different test does not stop a large call. These bounded prerequisites must not alter the grid used by the original bulk-work assertion. Preserve the 64-bit runtime and full declared numeric domain; do not remove valid large-step coverage merely to make discrimination cheaper. Add no private-coordinate injection, large physical allocation, timing assertion, new trait requirement, new arithmetic policy or expected panic. This is one test-only correction; the specification and both implementations remain unchanged.
